contea di ritrovamento: West Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)
IMP LICINIVS P F AVG ; GENIO [POP] ROM

Complete copper alloy Roman nummus, of Licinius, AD.308-324. mint of London. RIC volume 7, page 97 No.3 dating AD313-14. The obverse shows a bust right, with the legend visible. Legend: IMP LICINIVS P F AVG. The reverse is genius with modius on head to the left., loins draped with himation, patera in right hand and a cornucopiae in the left. Legend: GENIO [POP] ROM. with PLN in exergue. S/F in…
